consent.body: A device wants to view your screen using only the permissions you choose. Confirm who it is before you allow it.
consent.delay_hint: On a first connection, Allow becomes available after a few seconds.
consent.title: Connection request
error.auth_failed.hint: Check the code or password, then try again. The host may have issued a new code.
error.auth_rate_limited.hint: Wait and try again. Repeated guesses make the host pause this device.
error.cert_revoked.hint: Ask an administrator to issue a new certificate.
error.host_busy: The host is not accepting another session.
error.host_busy.hint: Ask the person at the host to close a session, then try again.
error.host_shutdown.hint: Wait until the computer is back, then connect again.
error.peer_blocked: This device is blocked by the host.
error.peer_blocked.hint: The person at the host has to remove the block before you can connect.
error.permission_revoked: A permission was removed during the session.
error.permission_revoked.hint: Ask the person at the host if you still need that permission.
error.policy_denied: The host policy refused this connection.
error.policy_denied.hint: The host only accepts the sign-in methods enabled in its settings.
error.proto_unsupported: The two apps do not share a protocol version.
error.proto_unsupported.hint: Update both apps and try again.
error.protocol_violation: The connection was closed because a peer broke the protocol.
error.protocol_violation.hint: Reconnect. If this keeps happening, update both apps.
error.rejected_by_user: The person at the host denied the connection.
error.rejected_by_user.hint: Ask them to accept the next request if you still need access.
error.session_expired: The session reached its time limit.
error.session_expired.hint: Connect again if the person at the host still agrees.
error.session_locked: The host session is locked and cannot be controlled remotely.
error.session_locked.hint: Someone at the host needs to unlock the screen.
error.timeout_user_response: The person at the host did not answer in time.
error.timeout_user_response.hint: Try again while they are at the computer.
error.unknown: The session closed for an unrecognized reason.
error.unknown.hint: Update the app so it understands this message, then try again.
error.unspecified.hint: Connect again. If it keeps happening, check the host log.
fraud.warning: If someone called you and told you to install this program, deny the connection. Banks, government agencies, and support companies do not ask you for remote access.
quick_support.no_unattended: Quick Support cannot set up unattended access.
session.indicator: A remote connection is active. This indicator cannot be turned off.
